titlePlain: Finding and Fixing a Duplicate-Event Bug From
subtitle: Video 16 of 20 · Fernbridge Logistics

eyebrow: The bug: ordering by arrival, not by event time
code:
# BEFORE
latest = Window.partitionBy("package_id") \
    .orderBy(F.col("kafka_ingest_timestamp").desc())
# a late-arriving OLD event can outrank a newer one
caption: Reproduced on command with two fabricated rows -- no live data needed.

eyebrow: The fix: trust the scanner's own clock
code:
# AFTER
latest = Window.partitionBy("package_id") \
    .orderBy(
        F.col("event_timestamp").desc(),
        F.col("kafka_ingest_timestamp").desc(),  # tiebreaker only
    )
caption: PKG-1048275 now resolves to DELIVERED -- matching Fabric exactly.

eyebrow: A test that makes sure it can't come back
code:
def test_late_arriving_old_event_does_not_win(spark):
    # older event, later arrival  vs  newer event, earlier arrival
    result = resolve_latest_status(df).collect()
    assert result[0]["status"] == "DELIVERED"
